[Relative Meeks--Yau theorem] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0260 1. ch33:33.26\group Minimal disks

The same least-area conclusion holds when the allowed boundary is any selected union of boundary components, provided the corresponding disk class is nonempty.
